name: How long does a pool area renovation project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a pool area renovation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pool area renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. Minor updates like replastering and new decking might take 2-4 weeks. More extensive renovations involving structural changes, new water features, or significant landscaping can extend to 6-12 weeks or more. Factors such as weather, material availability, and permitting processes can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
